# Swage

> Agent-facing documentation index for Swage, a context-governed agent platform that runs on your own hardware. Each linked page is the terse, canonical rendering of its subject; llms-full.txt carries the whole set in one file.

## General

- [Agents and permissions](agent-docs/agents-and-permissions.md): Agent definitions, operator guidance (AGENTS.md), tool permissions, approval mechanics, dispatch-bound grant intersection, and space-targeted session creation
- [First session](agent-docs/first-session.md): First-session walkthrough — open a space, attach a workspace, trust it so its AGENTS.md feeds agent context
- [Interfaces and tooling](agent-docs/interfaces-and-tooling.md): Turn context inspector, image attachments, wire error contract, route manifest and OpenAPI projection, verification gate, and client-side route handling
- [Workflow engine](agent-docs/workflow-engine.md): Run lifecycle, journal/replay, budget partitions, parking, wake gate, worker sessions, cancellation, and failure handover
